# NFL Daily — 2026-11-20 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Colts released QB Daniel Jones, 10 days after rebuffing trade interest from the Vikings and Ravens; Anthony Richardson takes over as starter. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2123840158537494716)
- Patriots QB Drake Maye has a fractured right fibula that won't need surgery but could sideline him the rest of the season. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2123855118877483470)
- Patriots WR A.J. Brown is expected to miss multiple weeks with a hamstring injury. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/patriots-wr-aj-brown-hamstring-injury-update/)
- Rams WR Puka Nacua had MCL surgery Tuesday and could miss the rest of the season; the NFL suspended him three games without knowing surgery had happened. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2123825241570841079)
- Cardinals turn to 40-year-old Josh Johnson at QB after Carson Beck's back spasms — their fourth different starter in five weeks. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2123834485284143113)

## Transactions
- Colts released QB Daniel Jones, less than a year into the 2-year, $88M deal that was the largest 2-year contract in NFL history; Anthony Richardson is the new starter. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50542293/colts-release-qb-daniel-jones-blowout-loss-texans)

## Injuries
- Patriots QB Drake Maye fractured his right fibula and could miss the rest of the season. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7789306/2026/11/20/drake-maye-injury-update-status-fracture-patriots/)
- Patriots WR A.J. Brown expected to miss multiple weeks with a hamstring injury. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/patriots-wr-aj-brown-hamstring-injury-update/)
- Rams WR Puka Nacua had knee surgery and is likely out for the season. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7798300/2026/11/20/puka-nacua-injury-update-status-knee-mcl-rams/)
- Cardinals QB Carson Beck is dealing with back spasms; veteran Josh Johnson is set to start Sunday at Kansas City. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/arizona-cardinals-qb-carson-beck-injury-josh-johnson)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-20 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- CB Marlon Humphrey was sent home Thursday and ruled out for Sunday's game at the Panthers after making derogatory remarks about teammates on his podcast; coach Jesse Minter expects him back at the facility Monday. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2123849536489800083)
- The Colts rebuffed Ravens trade interest in QB Daniel Jones before releasing him outright 10 days after the trade deadline. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2123843639755571670)
